EC1: Any previous treatments [AND] for active CSC;
EC2: Previous prescription of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, for cCSC [OR] or for other diseases;
EC3: Current treatment with corticosteroids  (topical or systemic) [OR], corticosteroid use within 3 months before possible start of trial treatment  [OR], or anticipated start of corticosteroid treatment within the first 2 years from the start of the trial period;
EC4: Evidence of another diagnosis that can explain serous SRF or visual loss;
EC6: Profound chorioretinal atrophy [AND] in central macular area on ophthalmoscopy and OCT;
EC8: Visual loss [OR] and/or serous detachment on OCT < 6 weeks;
EC9: Continuous [OR] and/or progressive visual loss  > 18 months [OR] or serous detachment [AND] on OCT > 18 months;
EC13: (relative) Contraindications [AND] for photodynamic treatment (pregnancy [OR], porphyria [OR], severely disturbed liver function). Pregnancy will not be routinely tested in female patients, but the possibility of pregnancy will be discussed during screening
EC14: (relative) Known contraindications [AND] for initiation of eplerenone treatment (hyperkalemia [OR], abnormal renal clearance [OR], severe hepatic insufficiency (Child-Pugh C) [OR], type 2 diabetes mellitus with microalbuminuria [OR], concomitant use of potassium supplements [OR], potassium-sparing diuretics [OR], strong CYP3A4 inhibitors [OR], or the combination of an ACE-inhibitor and an angiotensin receptor blocking agent). Pregnancy will not be routinely tested in female patients, but the possibility of pregnancy will be discussed during screening;
EC15: Soft drusen  in treated eye [OR] or fellow eye [OR], signs of choroidal neovascularization [AND] on ophthalmoscopy [OR] and/or FA [OR]/ICGA of the study eye.
